plugins.photosPermission: Allow Field Monitoring to access your photos to attach evidence for a visit.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Field Monitoring to access your camera to take evidence photos for a visit.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Field Monitoring to access your contacts so you can pick a phone number instead of typing it.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Field Monitoring to access your location to capture the GPS coordinates of a demo plot.
